title: LLM/VLM Fine-Tuning
description: QLoRA fine-tuning of a 9B vision-language model to answer questions about floor-plan images in structured JSON.
subtitle: Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B with QLoRA (Unsloth, TRL, PEFT) so it can read an architectural floor-plan image and answer questions about rooms, counts, junctions, and polygon annotations as structured JSON.
contributions: Built the chat-style JSONL dataset format for image + question + JSON answer pairs, with a split by source plan.
Wrote the Unsloth/TRL fine-tuning pipeline: 4-bit base loading, LoRA adapters on all linear layers, gradient checkpointing, periodic evaluation, early stopping, and resume.
Selected the best checkpoint by validation loss and merged the adapter into the base model for inference.
